digitization.source: Ambrosini et al. The CSV contains approximate group means and SEM read from the original JPEGs. Pixels start at the upper left. Convert each mean_y_px by linear interpolation between the two ticks. SEM is the absolute distance from the mean to the error-bar cap times units per pixel. No time point was assigned to the untreated controls.

S2B.file: supp_ddu201_ddu201supp.pdf, page 9, embedded image 0 (838 x 524 JPEG, extracted with pdfimages, not rendered)
S2B.note: points read as marker centres (filled disks by erosion, open circles as rings) at the drawn axis's -140 to -30 mV; SEM from the error-bar tip farther from the zero line, left empty where the bar ends inside its marker; WT at -80 mV is hidden behind K346T's marker and read from its connecting line

digitization.second_reader: Fig. 3G's two rows (reader second_reader in the CSV) were read by the FR-7 lane on 20 November 2026 by the same method, from the same JPEG (its SHA-256 checked against this manifest), with no other source: each mean is a bar's bottom edge (the bars hang down from 0), each SEM tip its error-bar cap, and the ticks are the axis's 0 and -25 marks. The rows marked first_reader are the user's (D241).
